players.product: thermal-spray coatings (plasma-resistant and electrostatic chuck coatings) applied to semiconductor and FPD manufacturing equipment parts

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026): net sales JPY 58,490 million (up 7.9%), operating profit JPY 14,102 million (up 15.0%; operating margin 24.1%), ordinary profit JPY 14,745 million (up 17.4%; ordinary margin 25.2%) and net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 10,060 million (up 25.0%). Management states semiconductor sales were strong on expanding generative-AI and data-center demand, and profit rose on higher sales of high value-added semiconductor products and better production efficiency despite higher depreciation from growth investment and higher raw-material and energy prices.

quarterly_data.signal: Mid-term plan TOCALO2030 (published May 2026; fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2031) targets for the year ending March 2031: net sales JPY 90,000 million (FY2026 actual JPY 58,490 million), of which semiconductor / FPD JPY 45,000 million (actual JPY 24,813 million), general industry JPY 26,000 million and subsidiaries JPY 19,000 million; ordinary profit JPY 20,000 million (ordinary margin 22.0%), ROE 15.0%. The company plans JPY 40 billion to JPY 60 billion of growth investment in semiconductor / FPD, general industry and overseas over five years, anticipating a doubling of production capacity for semiconductor-related parts toward 2030. Management states the semiconductor market is expected to exceed US$1.3 trillion in 2030, about 2.3 times 2022.
quarterly_data.figure: FY ending March 2031: net sales JPY 90,000 million; semiconductor / FPD JPY 45,000 million; ordinary profit JPY 20,000 million; investment JPY 40 billion to JPY 60 billion

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capex JPY 9,042 million: Thermal Spraying (standalone) JPY 6,770 million, mainly the new plant building at the Tokyo Plant and thermal-spray equipment for semiconductor / FPD at the Tokyo and Akashi plants; Domestic Subsidiaries JPY 525 million (coating equipment for capacity expansion at Japan Coating Center); Overseas Subsidiaries JPY 693 million (mainly semiconductor / FPD production equipment in Kunshan, China and Taiwan); Other JPY 846 million (new Kobe Plant building); corporate JPY 206 million (R&D equipment). Management states free cash flow was negative mainly because of aggressive investment to meet strong semiconductor-related demand, while current orders are firm.

quarterly_data.signal: Planned new facilities (Thermal Spraying): Tokyo Plant Gyoda site (Funabashi, Chiba) new plant building JPY 7,112 million (JPY 4,321 million paid), November 2024 to November 2026, being brought up to raise output for semiconductor-related customers; Kitakyushu Plant (Kanda, Fukuoka) new plant building JPY 3,511 million (JPY 404 million paid), December 2024 to November 2026; Nagoya Plant (Chita, Aichi) land for a new plant building JPY 1,481 million (JPY 136 million paid), October 2025 to April 2026, and the new plant building JPY 1,385 million, March 2026 to October 2027. Capacity increase not stated.
quarterly_data.figure: Tokyo JPY 7,112 million (Nov 2026); Kitakyushu JPY 3,511 million (Nov 2026); Nagoya land JPY 1,481 million and building JPY 1,385 million (Oct 2027)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 1,751 million (3.0% of net sales, in line with the about 3% target). In semiconductors Tocalo continued developing coatings for chamber parts and electrostatic chucks of memory and logic IC manufacturing equipment for equipment makers; for plasma etching equipment parts it is developing denser-film deposition processes, thermal-spray heaters and temperature-measurement technology for part temperature control, and simulation-based film design. Japan Coating Center advanced development of the ELIP PVD film, Slick nano DLC and THOR Slick ESD DLC films for semiconductor equipment and began processing its Equinox series for semiconductor parts. Taiwan subsidiary Hantai International Electronics added PVD deposition equipment at its newly completed Annan plant, with full commercial operation planned from the next fiscal year. Patent applications 37, registrations 29.
